issue_types.description: A form field has no label, so screen-reader users don't know what to type (placeholder isn't a label).
issue_types.expected_value: <label for> / wrapping <label> / aria-label on every field
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add a visible <label> linked to the field id.

issue_types.issue: aria-controls points to a missing id
issue_types.description: An ARIA reference points to an id that doesn't exist.
issue_types.expected_value: aria-labelledby / aria-describedby / aria-controls reference existing ids
issue_types.recommended_fix: Fix the id or the reference.

issue_types.description: An SVG marked role=img has no accessible name.
issue_types.expected_value: aria-label, aria-labelledby or <title> on role=img SVGs
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add aria-label, or aria-hidden="true" if decorative.

issue_types.issue: svg-img-alt: <svg> elements with an img role must have alternative text
issue_types.description: Ensure <svg> elements with an img, graphics-document or graphics-symbol role have accessible text
issue_types.recommended_fix:
Element has no child that is a title
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are - see https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/svg-img-alt?application=axeAPI

issue_types.issue: scrollable-region-focusable: Scrollable region must have keyboard access
issue_types.description: Ensure elements that have scrollable content are accessible by keyboard in Safari
issue_types.recommended_fix:
Element should have focusable content
  Element should be focusable - see https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/scrollable-region-focusable?application=axeAPI

issue_types.issue: aria-labelledby points to a missing id
issue_types.description: An ARIA reference points to an id that doesn't exist.
issue_types.expected_value: aria-labelledby / aria-describedby / aria-controls reference existing ids
issue_types.recommended_fix: Fix the id or the reference.

issue_types.issue: listitem: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
issue_types.recommended_fix: List item parent element has a role that is not role="list" - see https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/listitem?application=axeAPI

issue_types.issue: aria-hidden-focus: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
issue_types.description: Ensure aria-hidden elements are not focusable nor contain focusable elements
issue_types.recommended_fix: Focusable content should be disabled or be removed from the DOM - see https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/aria-hidden-focus?application=axeAPI

issue_types.description: Touch targets are smaller than the recommended 44x44 px.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Increase padding / min-height on the element.

issue_types.issue: Form without aria-live / role=alert region for error messages
issue_types.description: Form errors aren't announced to screen-reader users.
issue_types.expected_value: An aria-live / role=alert region for form messages
issue_types.recommended_fix: Render error/success messages inside an aria-live="polite" region.

issue_types.issue: landmark-unique: Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination
issue_types.recommended_fix: The landmark must have a unique aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title to make landmarks distinguishable - see https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/landmark-unique?application=axeAPI

issue_types.issue: empty-heading: Headings should not be empty
